title: TEEN Mythology Guild
description:
Step into a world of gods, heroes, monsters, and magic! The Teen Mythology Guild is the perfect place for mythology enthusiasts to connect, create, and have fun. Each meeting dives into fascinating myths from around the world—Greek, Norse, Egyptian, Japanese, and beyond—through lively discussions, creative crafts, and epic games. Whether you’re obsessed with Percy Jackson, love learning about ancient cultures, or just enjoy a good tale, this club is for you!

For teens ages 13-18. No registration required. This event is run by local teens from Classic Compass.

title: TWEENS Mythology Guild
description:
Can you recite all of the Ancient Greek gods and goddesses? Do you know everything there is to know about the Ancient Egyptian afterlife? Maybe you just love mythology of all kinds? Want to meet other kids who share your passion?

Join us at our Mythology Guild where we will explore a different world mythology each month!

This program is intended for children ages 9-13.
sponsor: Sponsored by Paideia’s 2026 Summer Teaching Literacy with Latin Grant
impactPoints:
Expanded the Teen Mythology Guild into an engaging introduction to Latin language, Roman mythology, and classical storytelling for younger learners
The Middle School (Tween) Mythology Guild will introduce students to myths from Ancient Greece and Rome through interactive lessons, hands-on crafts, collaborative games, and beginner Latin vocabulary
Sessions focussed on stories such as Theseus and the Minotaur, Persephone, Medusa, and Roman mythological creatures

title: YOUTH-Led Humanities
description: Stories That Shape Us is all about exploring the wild, weird, and wonderful world of folklore. Each week, we’ll jump into legends, ancient tales, family traditions, and myths. You’ll get to read, talk, create, and collaborate with other teens while discovering what makes stories so powerful.
